d: As US Secretary of State Marco Rubio prepares to visit India, trade negotiations, Russian oil purchases and strategic cooperation take centre stage. Meanwhile, Donald Trump has endorsed Benjamin Netanyahu ahead of Israel’s crucial election, despite months of tensions over the Iran war and military strategy. Firstpost examines the future of India-US ties, Washington’s unresolved trade and sanctions concerns, and the shifting Trump-Netanyahu relationship. Are these diplomatic moves driven by strategic interests or political calculations? Hem Kaur Saroya tells you more.
